body:

title: Docs: the monthly report downloads as a PDF
body:
**Scope now (2026-11-15):** The Download as PDF line is in place (a7f3e91b, `features/admin-dashboard.md` and its FR twin). Only left: one clause saying each page of the PDF names who the server is licensed to.

---

The Monthly report panel has a Download as PDF button, and each page of the PDF carries a footer naming who the server is licensed to. The client docs say so in one added clause.

## Files Scope

- `src/content/docs/en/features/admin-dashboard.md`
- `src/content/docs/fr/features/admin-dashboard.md`

Nothing else changes.

## Exact transform

In `src/content/docs/en/features/admin-dashboard.md`, section "Monthly report (Catena Business)", replace

`To keep a copy, press **Download as PDF**: the PDF holds the month the page shows.`

with

`To keep a copy, press **Download as PDF**: the PDF holds the month the page shows, and each of its pages names who the server is licensed to.`

In `src/content/docs/fr/features/admin-dashboard.md`, section "Rapport mensuel (Catena Business)", replace

`Pour en garder une copie, appuyez sur **Télécharger en PDF** : le PDF contient le mois que la page affiche.`

with

`Pour en garder une copie, appuyez sur **Télécharger en PDF** : le PDF contient le mois que la page affiche, et chacune de ses pages nomme le titulaire de la licence du serveur.`

- **Acceptance:** `npm run check` and `npm run build` pass; both sentences read as above, EN and FR together.

title: Docs: the notice for services pinned off automatic updates
body:
A service pinned with `vps.auto-update=off` shows, on Catena Pro, the version the patch policy allows and what the
scanner knows, on the administrator's Apps tile, and `/apps/pinned` confirms one move (the service's image moves, with
copies of its own volumes taken while it is paused; a rollback puts them back). The client docs do not describe that
notice.

- **Behaviour:** a page says what the notice shows and what the move does, in English and French.
- **Acceptance:** `npm run check` and `npm run build`.

Part of catenahq/ops#296 (Robustness: R2. Automatic CVE tracking and emergency-patch pipeline), which tracks the change across repositories. Blocked by catenahq/ops#517, the part before it in push order.

A Pro server scheduled every 15 minutes runs a backup every 15 minutes, and each backup after the first uploads only
what changed. The bench proves it on a licensed host: `backup_quarter_hourly` and `worm_round_trip` passed in run
2026-11-13T19-42-21-510d.

- **Acceptance:** `npm run check`.
